column1: # ZAP rule overrides. Tab separated: rule id, action, reason.
# WARN keeps a finding visible in the report but does not fail the build.
# IGNORE is only used where the finding is structurally impossible here, and
# each line says why. Nothing is ignored to make the scan pass.

column3: (Re-examine cache-control: the demo is a single page and a stale cache is a stale demo, not a leak)
(X-Content-Type-Options: worth adding, no user-supplied content is rendered)
(Information disclosure, suspicious comments: the page is deliberately commented for judges reading source)
(HSTS: terminated at Cloud Run's load balancer, not in this container)
(Permissions policy: no camera, geolocation or payment API is used)
(Timestamp disclosure: the run journal publishes its own timestamps on purpose, that is the product)
(Modern web application: the page is a modern web application)
(Sub-resource integrity: there are no external sub-resources, everything is inline)
